observations.purpose: Warm sequential workflow measurements; not detection accuracy

resource_boundary: Readings over the full runner window including warm-ups and evidence reads. Whole-device GPU and backend cgroup memory; observed maxima are not exact peaks or per-request allocations.
timing_boundary: Multipart POST to image response body or first completed video-status poll. One warm-up per scenario excluded from summaries. Batch throughput includes saved-result/provenance reads and intermediate report writes, not just inference.
limitations: Ten observations per scenario; nearest-rank p95 is the observed maximum, not a reliable population tail estimate.
Sequential batch throughput is not source-video FPS, concurrent-user capacity or pure detector speed.
The backend was manually started before preflight after a WSL bind-mount startup failure. Its original container and volumes were retained; no continuous overnight uptime is claimed.
No exclusive GPU-use claim; background readings and containers are retained.
Not a detector accuracy evaluation; the quality gate remains failed and dense-crowd support unestablished.

post_run_memory_snapshot.boundary: Post-run diagnostic, outside all timed requests and resource summaries.
post_run_memory_snapshot.note: The current/stat files are separate reads. This snapshot does not reconstruct memory composition at the earlier sampled maximum or establish a leak.
